title: Plastics Companies Are Writing Lesson Plans. What Could Go Wrong?
summary: The Plastic Pollution Coalition is calling for stricter school policies against the use of industry-sponsored learning materials. One involves the Society of Plastics Engineers, or SPE, a trade group that recently became a division of the Plastics Industry Association.
